items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I went with her to Binghamton, New York, at a theatre... I can say I once played for Bessie Smith.

ctx.x: Right! Now, we're still in the Thirties. Remember, there was an old vocalist by the name of Bessie Smith. She was pretty fair/fat(?). And we had an elderly Jewish gentleman in there, you know...until I found out he was her husband! But I remember her.
He was a sort of agent, I take it.
